# Posters

Agregarr can either auto-generate posters from templates or upload custom artwork per collection.

## Auto-Generated Posters

- Enabled by default; Agregarr selects the default poster template and renders artwork based on the collection title.
- Switch templates from the dropdown to apply a different template
- Disable auto-poster when you want to manage artwork manually

## Uploading Custom Art

- Use **Add Poster** to open the poster browser and choose or upload an image (JPEG, PNG, or WebP up to 10 MB).
- Removing a poster schedules it for deletion on the next sync; the original poster remains active in Plex until that happens.
- When multiple libraries are selected, each gets its own poster entry
